title: Beyond OAuth: Task-Scoped Authorization for AI Agents via Natural Language Slices
abstract: arXiv:2603.17170v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: AI agents increasingly execute users' natural-language (NL) tasks by calling Web services, yet today's Web authorizes these calls through OAuth, which grants permissions over operators (e.g., TRANSFER), not operations (operator plus operands, e.g., transfer $100 to Bob). This gap cannot be closed by refining scope granularity, because operands are combinatorial, quantitative, and often derived from runtime computations across servers. Operator-scoped authorization therefore inherently overprivileges agents.   We propose Precise Task-Scoped Implicit Authorization (PAuth): submitting a concrete NL task implicitly authorizes exactly the operations its faithful execution requires, even when the agent is compromised (e.g., by malware or prompt injection). Each server independently derives an NL slice, a symbolic specification of the expected call inspired by program slicing, and server-produced values are wrapped in signed envelopes

translated_title: 超越OAuth：通过自然语言切片实现AI代理的任务范围授权
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.17170v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：AI代理越来越多地通过调用Web服务来执行用户的自然语言（NL）任务，然而当今的Web通过OAuth对这些调用进行授权，OAuth授予的是对操作符（如转账）的权限，而非对操作（操作符加操作数，如转账100美元给Bob）的权限。这一差距无法通过细化权限范围来弥补，因为操作数是组合性、定量性的，且通常源自跨服务器的运行时计算。因此，基于操作符的授权本质上过度授权给代理。我们提出精确任务范围隐式授权（PAuth）：提交一个具体的自然语言任务，隐式地授权其忠实执行所需的确切操作，即使代理被攻破（例如，被恶意软件或提示注入攻击）。每个服务器独立推导出一个自然语言切片，这是一种受程序切片启发的预期调用的符号规范，且服务器生成的值被封装在签名信封中。
tldr: 本文提出PAuth方法，通过自然语言切片实现任务级精确授权，解决了OAuth基于操作符授权导致AI代理过度授权的问题，即使代理被攻破也能限制其执行范围。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PAuth, a task-scoped authorization method using natural language slices, addressing the overprivilege issue of OAuth's operator-based authorization for AI agents, even when agents are compromised.
